appendix.title: Editorial Notes
appendix.para: This appendix is part of the local publication apparatus and is not intended for direct Wikipedia publication.
The modular XML source is maintained with xi:include so each article section can evolve independently while the compiled article remains reproducible from git.
Downstream formats such as HTML, SVG-rich documentation, MathML-bearing content, and LaTeX-aware transformations should be layered from the DocBook article rather than hand-maintained separately.
